answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops a sybil farm. Each identity locks 40 POA in a vault for 20 epochs, and its inviter co-signs the same bond, so one vertex spawning a hundred clones funds a hundred bonds. Peers may dispute a fake; if it holds, the bond is slashed and half goes to the challenger. 1,000 fakes pay 40,000 POA against a 12,000 POA pool, while an honest agent pays once, undiluted. Clones share one root, like yarrow from one stem.
